performance.verdict: ROAS real but lumpy; GBP going dark is the quiet risk to fix.

findings.text: ROAS 3.37 over 28 days is healthy, but 28-day purchases cluster in 8 days; last 3 days (Aug 24–26) show 2 purchases vs 2 in prior 3 (Aug 21–23) — momentum is flat, not accelerating.
OVERDUE: Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 (due Aug 14) has no completion record; fresh real-footage creative is the documented fix for fatigue — this gap leaves the fatigue cycle unbroken.
GBP actions collapsed: last 3 days (Aug 24–26) total 1 action vs 88 in prior 3 (Aug 21–23) — a 99% drop. Last 2 days are zero. Channel may be dark or a data-pull failure.
Revenue is extremely spiky: 6 of 28 days account for all $5,028 revenue; zero-purchase days outnumber purchase days 20 to 8, suggesting audience pool exhaustion between bursts.
IG reach ticked up 0.77% 7d vs prior but the 3-day signal (Aug 24–26 avg: 859) is above the prior 3 (Aug 21–23 avg: 601) — organic reach is quietly recovering; worth protecting.

suggestions.text: Verify GBP data pull immediately; if confirmed dark, audit GBP listing for suspension or category change within 48 hours.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit zero for Aug 25–26 after averaging 29/day earlier in the month — a 99% drop in the 3-day window. Check whether this is a data-connector failure (Windsor/GBP API) or an actual listing issue (suspension, ownership, spam filter). Success looks like confirmed data flow resumption or listing status resolved by Aug 29. If the listing is genuinely suppressed, organic call volume (49 calls, 82 directions in 28d) is at risk.

suggestions.text: Escalate overdue Shoot 1 footage delivery; without new real-footage creative, audience exhaustion between purchase bursts will worsen.
suggestions.monday_update: The Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 was due Aug 14 and has no completion record. Zero-purchase days outnumber purchase days 20 to 8 in the last 28 days, consistent with the documented fatigue pattern from the test phase (retargeting frequency 11.5–24.4×). Real facility footage is the approved fix per SOW creative rules — no AI video, stock-footage edits only as interim. Push client (Haney/Ameer) for footage delivery; confirm new creative enters rotation by Sep 3 to hold the 3.37 ROAS before pools exhaust further.

suggestions.text: Watch 3-day purchase signal through Aug 30; ROAS floor is 3.37 — do not scale BWS - Sales - Muslims until 3 consecutive purchase days confirm the burst is sustained.
suggestions.monday_update: Aug 24–26 delivered only 2 purchases ($938.09 revenue) vs the campaign's best window (Aug 11–12: 6 purchases, $1,661.59 in a single day). The ROAS of 3.37 is the 28-day blended figure — the 3-day trend is flat, not rising. Re-check on Aug 30: if the next 3-day window shows 3+ purchases, scaling BWS - Sales - Muslims by up to 20% daily budget is defensible. If flat or falling, hold spend and prioritise the creative refresh (S2).
